guidance.summary: Aspiration to be in the 16 to 17% EBIT margin range
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: Sandeep Kalra: Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration. That will be our endeavour but we'll let the quarters pan by. We don't give forward looking guidance.
